otherValues.0x70: This is an MPU6500 clone, not an MPU6050. Most libraries still work with small changes.

gotchas.text: The address is 0x68, or 0x69 when AD0 is HIGH.
It starts in sleep mode and reads zeros until PWR_MGMT_1 (0x6B) is cleared. Libraries do this in begin(); your own code must too.

current.note: Gyroscope and accelerometer on with the DMP; chip only (the GY-521 power LED and regulator add more).

source.title: InvenSense MPU-6000/MPU-6050 Product Specification
source.section: Electrical characteristics: operating current 3.9 mA; sleep 5 µA

registers.note: Every register resets to 0x00 except PWR_MGMT_1 (0x40, asleep) and WHO_AM_I (0x68). INT_STATUS and the FIFO are left out on purpose: reading them clears flags or removes data.

registers.name: SMPLRT_DIV
registers.text: Sample rate divider: sample rate = gyro rate / (1 + this value). The gyro rate is 8 kHz with DLPF_CFG 0 or 7, else 1 kHz.

registers.name: CONFIG
registers.text: External sync pin and the digital low-pass filter.

fields.name: EXT_SYNC_SET
fields.text: Where the FSYNC pin level is stored.

values.1: FSYNC stored in bit 0 of TEMP_OUT_L.
values.2: FSYNC stored in bit 0 of GYRO_XOUT_L.
values.3: FSYNC stored in bit 0 of GYRO_YOUT_L.
values.4: FSYNC stored in bit 0 of GYRO_ZOUT_L.
values.5: FSYNC stored in bit 0 of ACCEL_XOUT_L.
values.6: FSYNC stored in bit 0 of ACCEL_YOUT_L.
values.7: FSYNC stored in bit 0 of ACCEL_ZOUT_L.

fields.name: DLPF_CFG
fields.text: Low-pass filter: lower numbers react faster, higher numbers are smoother.

registers.name: INT_PIN_CFG
registers.text: How the INT pin behaves, and the auxiliary I2C bypass.

fields.name: INT_LEVEL
fields.text: Active level of the INT pin.

fields.name: INT_OPEN
fields.text: Output type of the INT pin.

values.1: Held until the interrupt is cleared.

fields.name: FSYNC_INT_LEVEL
fields.text: Active level of the FSYNC pin as an interrupt.

fields.name: FSYNC_INT_EN
fields.text: FSYNC pin used as an interrupt.

fields.name: I2C_BYPASS_EN
fields.text: Connects the auxiliary pins XDA/XCL straight to the main I2C bus.

values.1: Bypass on: a chip on XDA/XCL is reachable from your board.

registers.name: INT_ENABLE
registers.text: Which events raise the INT pin.

fields.name: I2C_MST_INT_EN
fields.text: Interrupt from the auxiliary I2C master.

fields.name: DATA_RDY_EN
fields.text: Interrupt when a new reading is ready.

registers.name: ACCEL_XOUT
registers.text: Raw X acceleration. Divide by 16384 for g at the ±2 g range.

registers.name: ACCEL_YOUT
registers.text: Raw Y acceleration. Divide by 16384 for g at the ±2 g range.

registers.name: ACCEL_ZOUT
registers.text: Raw Z acceleration. Divide by 16384 for g at the ±2 g range.

registers.name: GYRO_XOUT
registers.text: Raw rotation around X. Divide by 131 for °/s at the ±250 °/s range.

registers.name: GYRO_YOUT
registers.text: Raw rotation around Y. Divide by 131 for °/s at the ±250 °/s range.

registers.name: GYRO_ZOUT
registers.text: Raw rotation around Z. Divide by 131 for °/s at the ±250 °/s range.

registers.name: USER_CTRL
registers.text: FIFO and auxiliary I2C master switches.

fields.name: I2C_MST_EN
fields.text: The auxiliary I2C master (for a chip on XDA/XCL).

fields.name: I2C_IF_DIS
fields.text: Switches the main interface to SPI (MPU-6000 only).

values.0: I2C interface on. The MPU6050 must keep this at 0.

fields.name: DEVICE_RESET
fields.text: Resets every register. Clears itself when done.

values.1: The sensor is asleep and reads zeros. Your code must clear bit 6 (libraries do it in begin()).

fields.name: CYCLE
fields.text: Cycle mode: wake up, take one sample, sleep again.

values.1: Cycle mode on, at the rate set by LP_WAKE_CTRL.
PLL with the X axis gyro (recommended).
values.2: PLL with the Y axis gyro.
values.3: PLL with the Z axis gyro.
values.4: PLL with an external 32.768 kHz clock.
values.5: PLL with an external 19.2 MHz clock.
values.7: Clock stopped: the chip does not measure.

registers.name: PWR_MGMT_2
registers.text: Wake-up rate in cycle mode, and axes put on standby.

fields.name: LP_WAKE_CTRL
fields.text: How often the chip wakes up in cycle mode.

values.1: Axis on standby: reads nothing new.
Axis on standby: reads nothing new.
Axis on standby: reads nothing new.
Axis on standby: reads nothing new.
Axis on standby: reads nothing new.
Axis on standby: reads nothing new.

registers.name: WHO_AM_I
registers.text: Chip ID. It stays 0x68 whatever the AD0 pin says.
